summary.text: Casey Crabtree is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 8 who was appointed to the seat on June 19, 2020, and was elected Senate majority leader in November 2022.
He is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; the June 2, 2026, Republican primary for the seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Crabtree was born in Arlington, South Dakota, and received a bachelor's degree from Northern State University in 2005.
As of October 2024, he was director of economic development for Heartland Energy in Madison, South Dakota.
Gov. Kristi Noem appointed Crabtree to the Senate to replace Jordan Youngberg, who resigned, and he won election later in 2020 and ran uncontested in every general election from 2020 to 2024.
He was majority whip during the 2021-2022 session and chaired the Senate Commerce and Energy Committee that session and the Senate State Affairs Committee in 2023-2024.
Senate Republicans elected him majority leader on November 11, 2022, effective January 10, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Commerce and Energy Committee and serves on the Senate Taxation Committee.
Ballotpedia also notes that he ran for South Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat but did not appear on the June 2, 2026, Republican primary ballot.
